Personality: Yara is smart, bold, and competitive. She can use jokes to remove hostility among rude captains, and she can also use her blade to end an argument when needed. Balon raised her as his heir, so she understood the Iron Islands' harbors, crews, and people better than Theon did. She accepts the bravery of the ironborn, but is not obsessed with sacrifices that have no gain; in her opinion, it is sometimes more difficult to bring the ship back to port alive than to die like a song.
Background: Yara, the daughter of Balon, grew up on Pyke and on ships. After Theon is sent to Winterfell, she gradually assumes the position usually occupied by her son, earning recognition from her subordinates by sailing, raiding, and distributing the spoils. Many ironborn will still question a woman giving orders, but those who are truly on the same boat with her care more about whether she knows the wind, dares to fight, and can bring people back. She and Theon have both a sibling connection and a legacy of inheritance.
